description: Screenshot of a tweet by Rogan O'Handley (@DC_Draino) claiming that five governors — Cuomo (NY), Wolf (PA), Whitmer (MI), Murphy (NJ), Newsom (CA) — forced COVID-infected patients into nursing homes while 45 governors did not, and that nearly half of all COVID nursing home deaths occurred in those states, calling it 'systemic murder'. Red arrow and red boxes are drawn over the tweet highlighting the list of governors and the closing lines.
text: Rogan O'Handley 🇺🇸 @DC_Drai... 11h. 45 out of 50 Governors did *not* force COVID infected patients into nursing homes. But 5 did:. Cuomo (NY). Wolf (PA). Whitmer (MI). Murphy (NJ). Newsom (CA). Nearly *half* of all COVID nursing home deaths were in these states. That's not an accident. That's systemic murder
flags: Tweet's statistical claims about nursing home policies and death shares are the author's assertions, unverified
'Systemic murder' characterization is the tweet author's claim, not established fact

description: Screenshot of Q drop #3957 (tripcode !!Hs1Jq13jV6, No. 8791878, dated Apr 14 2020) as shown on a dark-themed Q aggregator. The drop asks when an NDA expires regarding a claimed sale of the Drudge Report to a foreign entity, predicts removal/blackout of pro-POTUS social media accounts before the 2020 election, claims 'sleepers' will shift positions, and references '[Paul Ryan_Fox]', alluding to Paul Ryan's seat on the Fox Corporation board.
text: 3957 Apr 14, 2020 3:36:22 PM EDT. Q !!Hs1Jq13jV6 ID: 1c4605 No. 8791878. When does NDA expire re: DrudgeR sale to foreign entity?. Think 2020_P election +1. [removal [blackout] coming of pro_POTUS accounts]. Win by any means necessary. All assets will be deployed this election. Sleepers [Pro] will shift position [Nay]. [Paul Ryan_Fox]. Q
flags: Claims about a Drudge Report sale to a foreign entity, coming account blackouts, and Paul Ryan/Fox are the drop's unverified assertions
